PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JUNE 18, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

Kevin Scott, President  Gina Maguire, Commissioner
Gloria Cordero, Vice President  Al Austin II, Commissioner
Charles Parkin, Secretary

B. Anatole Falagán, General Manager  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney

  Members of the public have the option to email comments to commission@lbutilities.org

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

CONSENT CALENDAR

1.  26-55472  Recommendation to approve June 4, 2026 Board meeting minutes.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

REGULAR AGENDA

2.  26-55482  Recommendation to receive and file report on AWWA CA-NV Section Spring
  Conference Field Competitions.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-55483  Recommendation to adopt Request for Proposal (RFP) for Engineering Design
  Services for the Los Angeles Department of Water and Power (LADWP) Haynes
  Generating Station Water Main Improvement Project (MC-5276), and award a
  contract to GHD Inc. in a total amount not to exceed $642,513, for a period of three
  years; and authorize the General Manager to execute all documents necessary to
  enter into the contract, including any amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-55484  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute all documents
  necessary to amend Agreement WD-3705 with the Los Angeles Department of
  Water and Power (LADWP) relating to the recycled water and sanitary sewer
  pipeline improvements for the Haynes Generating Station (Haynes) to expand the
  scope of work to include potable water pipeline improvements and modifications to
  the wastewater discharge location, to increase the contract amount by
  $10,000,000 for a revised contract amount not to exceed $70,000,000, and extend

  Page 1 of 4
   PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JUNE 18, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

  the term to December 31, 2030.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-55485  Recommendation to adopt Specifications WD-04-25 and award contracts to (1)
  Charles King Company, Inc., (2) Mike Prlich & and Sons, Inc., (3) W.A. Rasic
  Energy & Infrastructure Services, Inc., and (4) Ramona, Inc., to provide on-call
  emergency water and sewer repair services, each with a not-to-exceed amount of
  $1,500,000, for an aggregate total amount not to exceed $6,000,000, for a period
  of two years, with the option to renew for one additional one year period; and
  authorize the General Manager to execute all document necessary to enter into the
  contracts, including any amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  26-55486  Recommendation to adopt Resolution No. UT-1564 authorizing the General
  Manager to execute a contract and any necessary documents, including any
  amendments, with CaliforniaGovConnection, Inc., for the purchase of technology
  products, services, and solutions, on the same terms and conditions afforded to
  the County of Fairfax, VA (Contract No. 4400012308), except as modified by
  mutual agreement of the Board and CaliforniaGovConnection, Inc, in an annual
  amount not to exceed $500,000, until the County of Fairfax, VA contract expires on
  October 31, 2028, with the option to renew for as long as the County of Fairfax, VA
  contract is in effect, at the discretion of the General Manager.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  26-55487  Recommendation to receive and file Water Resources Plan Water Supply
  Pathways Update.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Utilities Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Board.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Dynna Long, Executive Assistant to the Board, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72
hours prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
